cerebrium.notes: Cerebrium bills GPU+CPU+memory per second only while an app is active. Its H100-hour equivalent is below the Nebius on-demand H100 quote and above the preemptible quote, but no per-request cost is computable fail-closed until the sibling benchmark produces measured request latency.
cerebrium.reason: The sibling task catalog-switch-cerebrium-qwen3-glm52-benchmark is implemented but fail-closed at entitlement/capacity gates; no measured Cerebrium latency exists in this program as of 2026-08-19.

fixed_monthly_overheads_usd.notes: As-deployed measured-tier shapes: one 4 TiB network_ssd SFS holding artifacts/caches and one cpu-d3 controller node.

models.cost_notes: GPU critical path only (T0 through second semantic response on a 1x H100 instance quote). Node provision, pre-T0 setup, warm idle, storage, and controller costs are separate rows. Pessimistic = rule-of-three retry multiplier from the measured 0/20 failure denominator.
